title: Spiders Reality Climbing
description: This Datapack modifies spiders to have a size similar to real life but so little so exaggerated to be able to kill them facially.
body:
![Spiders Reality Climbing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/543479b98c78c5c4e50668898a957db41f0e57df.png)

This Datapack modifies spiders to have a size similar to real life but so little so exaggerated to be able to kill them facially.
